meta.title: Release platform v2.4 clean executable authority specification
meta.author: Codex release manager

feature.problem_statement: v2.4 is a clean-room executable release-authority contract that closes v2.1/v2.2/v2.3 council findings without inheriting their semantic arrays or validators.
goals: Bind every semantic requirement to executable evidence.
non_goals: Live GitHub, Vault, registry, Kubernetes or Argo mutation.
Treating offline fixtures as production authority.

requirements.statement: Freeze the v2.4 artifact set with canonical JSON bytes and a fixed generation clock.
requirements.rationale: A repeated build must have identical bytes.

requirements.statement: Bind the v2.2 baseline spec and annex digests before planning changes.
requirements.rationale: Historical inputs must be exact.

requirements.statement: Resolve NEXT_SEMVER as the first verified tag greater than every verified v0.7.x tag and freeze it at X39.
requirements.rationale: The obsolete v0.6.14 prerequisite is not reused.

requirements.statement: Materialize one S00 root and reject any second root or unreachable success node.
requirements.rationale: A graph with two roots can bypass gates.

requirements.statement: Run AP20 through AP25 in app-config, with only bootstrap wiring and an explicit join to X41.
requirements.rationale: App-config owns bootstrap wiring, not workload desired state.

requirements.statement: Bind every DAG command to immutable argv, digest, no shell and no network.
requirements.rationale: A writer cannot substitute a broader command.

requirements.statement: Validate each typed payload against an actual strict JSON schema before predicate evaluation.
requirements.rationale: Shape errors must fail before authority.

requirements.statement: Sign the exact RFC 8785-compatible payload bytes inside an offline DSSE-style envelope.
requirements.rationale: Fixture signatures must be cryptographically verifiable.

requirements.statement: Treat offline fixture signatures as authority=false and reject Sigstore or Vault evidence without complete live verification inputs.
requirements.rationale: Synthetic records must never authorize publication.

requirements.statement: Compare issued_at and expires_at with an injected fixed clock and thirty-second skew.
requirements.rationale: Freshness must not use wall-clock variance.

requirements.statement: Reject a nonce present in the durable replay ledger, including when two validator processes read the same snapshot.
requirements.rationale: Replay state survives process boundaries.

requirements.statement: Recompute immutable repository, Kubernetes and artifact target bindings instead of trusting declared target text.
requirements.rationale: Authority must be scoped to one target.

requirements.statement: Derive pre-target and post-target digests and effect count from bytes independently of declared counts.
requirements.rationale: A declaration cannot hide a partial effect.

requirements.statement: Execute every negative as a distinct patch through schema, signature, predicate and ledger evaluators.
requirements.rationale: Each failure has an executable oracle.

requirements.statement: Link exactly four signed records per M01 through M19 with a predecessor hash chain.
requirements.rationale: Writer, collector, signer and committer actions remain separate.

requirements.statement: Publish fourteen named assets with exact media type, source digest and destination binding.
requirements.rationale: Asset identity must be independently read back.

requirements.statement: Keep app-config paths limited to bootstrap descriptors and prohibit workload chart or values ownership.
requirements.rationale: The app-of-apps boundary stays narrow.

requirements.statement: Require normal administration to use three exact distinct identities, bounded TTL, one-use credentials, audit and revocation.
requirements.rationale: Routine control must be attributable.

requirements.statement: Require break-glass to use two exact approvers and a distinct executor with shorter TTL and forbidden publish operations.
requirements.rationale: Emergency access cannot become release authority.

requirements.statement: Verify candidate archive media, byte length and digest before no-network extraction.
requirements.rationale: Unverified bytes must not enter the release workspace.

requirements.statement: Verify Vault transit role, exact Kubernetes identity and revoked-key state before secret evidence is accepted.
requirements.rationale: Secret authority is narrow and auditable.

requirements.statement: Require the three-node PostgreSQL placement and TLS identity contract before release-platform workloads.
requirements.rationale: Data availability is a prerequisite.

requirements.statement: Allow only the enumerated GitHub proxy operations with fixed host, listener, audience and SNI.
requirements.rationale: An unlisted proxy call is not a release capability.

requirements.statement: Route every UNKNOWN, TIMEOUT, PARTIAL_EFFECT and MISMATCH from every executable node to atomic U00.
requirements.rationale: No failure can skip fencing.

requirements.statement: Traverse U00 through U08 as fence, cancel, quarantine, revoke, reconcile, successor, audit and terminal actions.
requirements.rationale: Recovery is one reachable state machine.

requirements.statement: Join AP25 to X41 before any release mutation node is reachable.
requirements.rationale: Bootstrap completion is ordered before publication.

requirements.statement: Map every requirement, criterion and executable test to its own semantic node, command, schema and oracles.
requirements.rationale: Traceability must prove behavior, not labels.

requirements.statement: Hash the pre-council bundle manifest over spec, annex, spec-check, fixtures, builder and validator.
requirements.rationale: The review input cannot drift silently.

requirements.statement: Hash the pre-council validator report over the bundle hash and all computed results.
requirements.rationale: Validation output is bound to the exact bundle.

requirements.statement: Require detached council lane signatures, verdicts, manifest hash and report hash in a closure check.
requirements.rationale: Council closure must not self-reference its input bundle.

requirements.statement: Keep activation BLOCKED_PREACTIVATION with zero live gates and reject any live promotion command.
requirements.rationale: No fixture can activate the live pipeline.

requirements.statement: Record the objective change from the historical v0.6.14 prerequisite to the monotonic NEXT_SEMVER resolver.
requirements.rationale: Release identity follows verified tags at implementation time.

perspectives.summary: Clean-room semantic DAG and detached closure are required.
Offline signatures are non-authoritative and live evidence is rejected without full verification.
App-config is bootstrap-only and live gates remain blocked.
Every negative executes with independent effect and replay checks.

council.consensus_summary: Pre-council artifacts are reviewable but live activation is blocked.
open_questions: External council must supply four signed lane verdicts over the manifest and report hashes.
